profile.headline: Information Technology and Services Professional
profile.summary: I am a highly motivated individual with a degree in Management Information Systems from Iowa State. I have experience with a broad area of technology with hardware, programming, and customer support. I am pursuing opportunities in the Business and Technology field.

positions.title: Programmer I
positions.description:
Working on the policy administration system.
Using a scripting language to calculate and keep track of values for annuity and life insurance policies.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Supporting Macola (an enterprise resource planning system)
Creating/modifying reports in SSRS and Crystal
SQL
Communicated effectively with clients
Team Foundation updating work items, verifying completed items, assigning tasks to team members

positions.title: Computer Technician
positions.description:
Prepare computers and other electronics for resale by testing and wiping data
Hardware troubleshooting swapping out parts as needed
Assist in pricing products

positions.title: Portal Team Intern
positions.description:
Provide support for various clients using SharePoint
PowerShell - manage site backups, site restores, manage services on servers
Use of CSS and JavaScript to develop web pages 
SharePoint administration
Troubleshooting SharePoint servers: performance, services
Customer Support: Handling end user features, changing site permissions

positions.title: Computer Technician Internship
positions.description:
Imaging computers using Windows Imaging Service
Phone support
Modifying Windows registry

positions.title: Information Technology Internship
positions.description:
Phone support for computer troubleshooting for sales representatives across the US and Canada
Creating a Ad hoc Networks to enable data transfer for upgrading PCs
Upgrading PCs from Windows XP to Windows 7
Outlook configuration
Joining PCs to company domain
Assisted end users in Adware and spyware removal
